meaning: Intensifies adjectives or other adverbs.
In a good or proper manner.
In a bad or improper manner.
At all times; on every occasion.
At no time; not ever.
Before or by now; can also mean 'right now'.
At the present time or moment.
At a later time; following something.
At an earlier time; prior to something.
Afterwards; at a subsequent time.
In or at this place.
In or at that place (more distant).
In or at that place (closer than 'allí').
At a great distance.
At a short distance.
At high speed; in a fast manner.
At a slow pace.
And no one or nothing else; exclusively.
Only; exclusively (can also be an adjective meaning alone).
In addition; as well.
